summary: Final VIP system test (iteration 87). Backend: 5/5 tests pass. GET /api/vip/permissions returns EXACTLY the 6 VIP feature flags (atlas_memory, chart_analysis, market_intelligence, personalized_learning, daily_briefing, advanced_tools) - NO fear_greed / voice fields. GET /api/vip/daily-briefing?lang=fr returns a real briefing envelope {success:true, data:{market_summary, btc_analysis, eth_analysis, sentiment, key_events, opportunity, risk, ...}} generated by gpt-5.6-terra. POST /api/vip/ai/analyze-image returns 200 with analysis payload (native openai SDK). POST /api/atlas/chat for the VIP user does NOT include the upgrade_prompt field (correct). Frontend: /vip renders EXACTLY the 6 feature cards + $21.99 Stripe CTA and never mentions Fear & Greed or Voice. /vip/hub (authenticated VIP) renders Today's Briefing card, 6-card 'Your VIP Features' grid and the 'Open Atlas' CTA. /profile shows the golden VIP badge, Super Admin badge, VIP Hub menu row and no 'Become VIP' upsell. /learn shows the purple image/camera upload icon for VIP (visible in DOM/screenshots) - functionality confirmed. ONE spec violation found: the AI-generated Daily Briefing content contains literal 'Fear & Greed Index: 56' text (in market_summary and key_events). The spec explicitly says 'Fear & Greed' must not appear anywhere in VIP-related UI or API responses - so the daily-briefing OpenAI prompt needs to be tightened to forbid mentioning the F&G index by name.

minor.issue: AI-generated content (market_summary, key_events) literally contains 'Fear & Greed Index: 56 (Greed)'. Spec forbids 'Fear & Greed' text anywhere. Prompt in server.py daily-briefing generator must be updated to instruct the model to not reference the Fear & Greed Index by name (use 'market sentiment' instead).

rca of the issue: Root cause: the OpenAI daily-briefing prompt does not forbid the model from naming the 'Fear & Greed Index'. The model happily produces 'Fear & Greed Index: 56 (Greed)' inside market_summary/key_events. The generated payload is then cached in db.daily_briefings for 4 hours and rendered verbatim by /vip/hub. Reproduction: (1) login as VIP, (2) GET /api/vip/daily-briefing?lang=en, (3) inspect data.market_summary and data.key_events. Mitigation: add explicit 'DO NOT mention Fear & Greed Index by name; refer to it only as market sentiment' rule to the system prompt AND add a defensive .replace('Fear & Greed', 'market sentiment') sanitizer on the generated text before persisting/returning; then purge existing daily_briefings cache rows.
